question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.
sql:
WITH daily_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            ELSE -txn_amount 
        END) as net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as earliest_date,
        MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as latest_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        cdr.customer_id,
        d as txn_date
    FROM customer_date_ranges cdr,
    UNNEST(generate_series(cdr.earliest_date, cdr.latest_date, INTERVAL '1 day')) AS t(d)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.txn_date,
        COALESCE(dc.net_change, 0) as net_change
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc 
        ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dc.txn_date
),
running_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        net_change,
        SUM(net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
final_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM running_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as month,
        customer_id,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM final_balances
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date), customer_id
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
